bug_semantics: When the image proxy is enabled, an authenticated forum user can embed an attacker-chosen non-HTTPS URL in an IMG BBCode tag. SMF rewrites that URL into its own proxy.php URL and computes the required HMAC/hash with the server-side image-proxy secret, so the hash check is not an authorization boundary against that user. The proxy then performs a server-side fetch. Before the fix, destination validation was absent or limited to literal IP addresses and the exact hostname localhost; a public-looking hostname that resolved to loopback, RFC1918, link-local/cloud-metadata, or another reserved address, and redirects to such an address, reached the fetchers. This permits SSRF into services visible to the SMF host.
flaw_origin: The root flaw was introduced by the original image-proxy endpoint in dcbaefb0976cf3e9d9490455bb59504d5c807847: proxy.php accepted a signed request URL and passed it directly to curl_fetch_web_data::get_url_data without validating the resolved destination. Follow-up commits in the same feature series supplied enabled defaults (f7a3f2b5b0bcc538637fd48ff273f094bcbc85e4), automatically signed attacker-controlled BBCode image URLs (a892a53ba45330d69b8ad8b1ede82aebaa29537b), added avatar use (d12746587bbf9b4015854677ac2a2916937116e5), and exposed settings (cc52ef5f6fae05bb41a66817758971d7a2063681). Those commits completed and broadened the attack path, but dcbaefb0976cf3e9d9490455bb59504d5c807847 is the smallest commit that first wrote the unsafe server-side fetch rather than a later move or refactor.
ai_marker: The BIC commit object, inspected with `git cat-file -p dcbaefb0976cf3e9d9490455bb59504d5c807847`, names human author and committer Shitiz Garg <mail@dragooon.net> and contains only `Signed-off-by: Shitiz Garg <mail@dragooon.net>`. It has no AI Co-Authored-By trailer, Generated-with trailer, bot identity, or other AI marker. AI attribution on the 2026 fix is intentionally excluded because the protocol permits BIC-object evidence only.
evidence: The assigned GHSA bundle identifies CWE-918, describes authenticated IMG-BBCode abuse plus automatic signature generation, and cites the two closing merge commits 4bf35cf9e45573a5f55a6f52995086c1da89c096 and b4d23dfd74a511587c605f9d294cefc3a75b4b26.

`git show --format=fuller --stat dcbaefb0976cf3e9d9490455bb59504d5c807847` shows the human-authored 2014 commit `Implement an Image Proxy`, adding proxy.php. Its cacheImage method constructs curl_fetch_web_data and executes `$curl->get_url_data($request)` with the signed request URL but no host resolution or private/reserved-address check.

Both history probes identify the same origin: `git log --all --reverse -S'$curl->get_url_data($request)' -- proxy.php Sources/ProxyServer.php` first returns dcbaefb0976cf3e9d9490455bb59504d5c807847, and `git log -L 98,100:proxy.php dcbaefb0976cf3e9d9490455bb59504d5c807847` attributes the three fetch lines to that new-file commit. The later f656bc2f1336580eebeb243b4294e6491ade5d56 change merely replaced the fetch implementation and is not the BIC.

Direct parent absence is reproducible with `git rev-parse dcbaefb0976cf3e9d9490455bb59504d5c807847^`, which yields eb7314fc8e763023a2f02790669e1d224a6a74d6; `git ls-tree -r eb7314fc8e763023a2f02790669e1d224a6a74d6 -- proxy.php` returns no entry, while `git diff --name-status eb7314fc8e763023a2f02790669e1d224a6a74d6 dcbaefb0976cf3e9d9490455bb59504d5c807847 -- proxy.php` reports `A proxy.php`.

The feature lifecycle is visible with `git log --ancestry-path --reverse dcbaefb0976cf3e9d9490455bb59504d5c807847^..cc52ef5f6fae05bb41a66817758971d7a2063681`: dcbaefb adds the unsafe endpoint, f7a3f2b adds enabled image-proxy defaults, a892a53 adds automatic proxy URL and hash generation for IMG BBCode, d127465 adds avatar use, and cc52ef5 adds administrative settings. `git show a892a53ba45330d69b8ad8b1ede82aebaa29537b -- Sources/Subs.php` shows the exact rewrite to `/proxy.php?request=` plus `md5($data . $image_proxy_secret)`.

`git tag --contains dcbaefb0976cf3e9d9490455bb59504d5c807847` starts with 2.1beta1/v2.1-beta.1 and includes every 2.1 tag through v2.1.7 and every 3.0 tag through v3.0-alpha.4. Neither `git tag --contains 4bf35cf9e45573a5f55a6f52995086c1da89c096` nor `git tag --contains b4d23dfd74a511587c605f9d294cefc3a75b4b26` returns a tag in the frozen clone, so the precise closing boundary is commit-based rather than a fixed release tag.

`git show --format=fuller 4bf35cf9e45573a5f55a6f52995086c1da89c096` shows a merge with first parent 57d30d5a0ec32073d0dd1fe5b038d41dd84171b3 and second parent ce59add4bdcacea557fb9a9763ad4b24d75a8a48. `git log 57d30d5a0ec32073d0dd1fe5b038d41dd84171b3..ce59add4bdcacea557fb9a9763ad4b24d75a8a48` decomposes the modern fix series; its first direct fix is 6d8b5f2d5ddf14b26bf6e9e0812db9327770902d, which adds the central WebFetchApi safety check and redirect revalidation. The final merge checks resolved addresses and rejects non-global/private/reserved destinations. `git branch -a --contains 4bf35cf...` places this fix on release-3.0, and index.php at the fix identifies the line as 3.0 Alpha 4.

The parallel 2.1 closing boundary is b4d23dfd74a511587c605f9d294cefc3a75b4b26 on origin/release-2.1. It merges the single direct commit 10a998ccbae25bd95d4c3857a66a30b018bb5fda over parent 3c98cab9b6ca9c247da4b43d2879dcb61c0af568. `git diff 3c98cab9b6ca9c247da4b43d2879dcb61c0af568 b4d23dfd74a511587c605f9d294cefc3a75b4b26 -- proxy.php Sources/Subs.php Sources/Class-CurlFetchWeb.php` shows the equivalent `is_fetch_safe` resolved-address guard on initial fetches, proxy requests, and redirects; index.php at this boundary identifies the line as 2.1.7.

`git cat-file -p dcbaefb0976cf3e9d9490455bb59504d5c807847` is the sole AI-evidence source used for the verdict: human author/committer Shitiz Garg and a human Signed-off-by trailer, with no AI or bot marker. The Co-Authored-By marker present on direct fix 6d8b5f2d5ddf14b26bf6e9e0812db9327770902d is later fix-only evidence and therefore cannot make the vulnerability AI-authored.
reasoning: The vulnerable operation is the server-side dereference of the signed, user-selected image URL without validating the resolved destination. That operation first appears when proxy.php is created in dcbaefb0976cf3e9d9490455bb59504d5c807847, and its immediate parent has no proxy.php at all. Later automatic signing and configuration commits make the primitive readily reachable but do not precede the unsafe fetch line, while subsequent class moves and fetch refactors preserve rather than originate it. The 2026 fixes close both maintained lines by applying public/global-address checks before the initial connection and again across redirects. Because the only admissible AI evidence is the BIC commit object and that object has only human identities and a human sign-off, the closed verdict is NOT_AI regardless of AI assistance disclosed on a later fix commit.
